python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
import random
from tenacity import Retrying, RetryCallState, wait_random_exponential
random.seed(7)
state = RetryCallState(retry_object=Retrying(), fn=None, args=(), kwargs={})
waiter = wait_random_exponential(multiplier=1, min=5, max=60)
for attempt in (1, 2, 4):
    state.attempt_number = attempt
    value = waiter(state)
    upper = max(5, min(60, 2 ** (attempt - 1)))
    print("attempt:", attempt, "wait:", value, "expected_interval:", (5, upper))
    assert 5 <= value <= upper
